question: Should `photoscrawl classify` accept arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoint URLs for Photos-derived image bytes, or should this feature be constrained or disclosed as local-only before merge?
rationale: The PR adds a user-facing endpoint flag on a private-media classification path, so maintainers need to choose whether non-loopback endpoints are allowed and how that affects docs and evidence metadata.

options.title: Require local-only guard or disclosure
options.body: Merge only after the PR either rejects non-loopback classify endpoints or clearly documents and records that remote endpoints receive image bytes.

options.title: Allow arbitrary advanced endpoints
options.body: Accept remote OpenAI-compatible endpoints as an intentional advanced opt-in and require metadata/docs to reflect that policy.

options.title: Defer the provider surface
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it until the local-model provider policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Require local-only guard or disclosure
recommendation.body: Merge only after the PR either rejects non-loopback classify endpoints or clearly documents and records that remote endpoints receive image bytes.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 introduced the local multimodal classifier and classify command surface that define the privacy boundary being extended.
